issue: DistantHorizonsStandalone #64 - Loading a world with shaders enabled does not render LODs

findings.summary: LODs do not render when shaders are enabled at world load. The IrisAccessor checks if shader pack is in use and if rendering shadow pass. The deferred rendering path (for shaders) may fail to initialize properly when shaders are already enabled at load time.
findings.root_cause: DhApiRenderProxy.deferTransparentRendering defaults to false, and the rendering path selection in LodRenderer.renderLodPass() may not properly handle the case where shaders are enabled before DH initialization. The shadow pass detection may also interfere with normal rendering.
evidence: LodRenderer.java:122-124: Checks deferTransparentRendering to determine render path
RenderBufferHandler.java:138-142: Shadow pass detection may skip rendering
RenderHelper.java:46-48: drawDeferredLods() returns early if angelicaCompat == null

primary.issue: Defaults to false, should detect shader state at init
Early return if running deferred pass but deferTransparentRendering is false

gap_analysis.current_behavior: LODs may not render when shaders are enabled at world load
gap_analysis.required_behavior: LODs should render regardless of when shaders are enabled
gap_analysis.invariant_violated: Rendering should work with or without shaders at load time

proposed_fix.approach: Detect shader state at initialization and set deferTransparentRendering accordingly; ensure render path selection handles shader toggle properly
implementation_steps: 2. Set deferTransparentRendering based on shader state
3. Add listener for shader enable/disable to update render mode
4. Ensure render path re-evaluates when shader state changes
proposed_fix.code_changes: Add shader state detection and dynamic render mode switching

falsification_test.description: If LODs still don't render after dynamic shader detection, issue is in shader compatibility layer
steps: 2. Load world with shaders already enabled
3. If still broken, check GlDhTerrainShaderProgram initialization with shaders

confidence_reason: Clear code path identified but exact failure point depends on shader initialization timing which is hard to verify without runtime debugging
